instruction: Please help me change the font size in VS Code to 16.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.fontSize": 12}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.fontSize" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.fontSize": [0-9]\+/"editor.fontSize": 12/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.fontSize": 12}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing VS Code font size from 12 to 16. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.fontSize setting in settings.json.
